## Description
Provide a concise explanation of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing a mechanics, formula, or asset issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding scouting, simulation, or UI capability)
- [ ] Optimization (performance enhancement, memory reduction, code refactoring)
- [ ] Documentation / Agent Rule update

## Pre-Flight Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres strictly to Regulation M-C rules and the species blacklist.
- [ ] All public classes, methods, and functions include PEP 257 docstrings.
- [ ] The local CI/CD test runner passes cleanly (`run_tests.cmd` or `bash run_tests.sh`).
- [ ] Zero linting violations (`flake8` / `pycodestyle` 0 errors).
- [ ] Static guardrails and path audits pass (`evals/run_static_checks.py`).
- [ ] No personal credentials, internal tokens, or unverified external strings are committed.
